g.text: Takeaway: for a lens the taper is an angular source — one lobe, ≈20° / ≈16–18° at half maximum on the Fig 5.28b cuts (≈40° FWHM per the text); the lens must capture it.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #93a1b5

g.text: Panels (a)/(b): model far field — Gaussian near-field → far-field projection, calibrated to Fig 5.28b (20° / 17°); not the book’s raw FDTD output.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #93a1b5

g.text: FWHM read from the model curves at 0.5: 20.00° (vertical) / 17.00° (horizontal); the same curves computed by FFT of the near field agree to < 0.01°.
